name: smart-electricity-web
description: Web app for the Smart Electricity System (Senior Project II)

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.migration:run: npm run build:server && typeorm-ts-node-commonjs migration:run -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:revert: npm run build:server && typeorm-ts-node-commonjs migration:revert -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:show: npm run build:server && typeorm-ts-node-commonjs migration:show -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.test: npm run build:server && node --test dist/src/test/analytics.test.js dist/src/test/api.test.js
